description: This file contains SwiftUI views and supporting code for displaying chat messages, including message bubbles, attachments, tool call cards, and typing indicators. It defines custom shapes, view components, and utility structures to render a chat UI with different message styles and states.

classes.name: ChatBubbleShape
classes.description: A custom shape for chat bubbles with optional tails (left, right, none). Implements insettable shape and provides path drawing logic for bubble with tails.

classes.name: ChatMessageBubble
classes.description: Main view for rendering a chat message bubble, styling it based on whether it's a user or assistant message, and handling appearance and layout.

classes.name: ChatMessageBody
classes.description: Private view component that handles the content of a chat message, including rendering text, attachments, tool calls, and tool results with appropriate styling.

classes.name: AttachmentRow
classes.description: View for displaying an attachment within a message, with an icon and filename.

classes.name: ToolCallCard
classes.description: View representing a card summarizing a tool call, including name and optional description.

classes.name: ToolResultCard
classes.description: View for displaying tool result output, with toggle for full/preview mode.

classes.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
classes.description: View showing animated dots indicating typing or processing state.

classes.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
classes.description: View for showing an ongoing streaming response from the assistant.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
classes.description: View listing the currently executing tools, with progress indicators.

classes.name: ChatAssistantTextBody
classes.description: Rendering component for assistant message content with markdown parsing

methods.name: inset
methods.description: Creates an inset version of the shape with increased inset amount.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Generates the path for the chat bubble shape with optional tail (left/right/none).

methods.name: addBottomEdge
methods.description: Helper to add bottom edge arc to bubble path.
